The Gigabit Broadband Voucher Scheme guidance was updated on 16 March 2026.
GBVS is part of Project Gigabit.
GBVS supports homes and businesses outside suppliers' commercial plans.
Most Project Gigabit delivery is expected through major subsidised supplier contracts.
GBVS supports localised projects using small grants aggregated by suppliers.
GBVS operates where there is no Project Gigabit procurement or contract and no existing or planned commercial coverage.
Eligible homes and businesses can access vouchers worth up to £4,500.
Eligible premises must have existing broadband download speeds below 1 Gbps.
A commercial gigabit-capable build must be unlikely in the near future.
No government-funded network-improvement contract may be planned or in place.
Eligible premises cannot be vacant, unoccupied or derelict.
Eligible premises cannot have been built within the previous two years.
